theorems.name: Submission.rsod_wfu_lusin_closed_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ϑ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → Measurable ϑ → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ i, IsClosed (C i) ∧ C i ⊆ A ∧ ContinuousOn ϑ (C i)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (A \ ⋃ i, C i) = 0
